description: A character holding one arm raised and extended, gesturing/pointing toward something off to the side with a small repeated emphasis motion. Best for calling out a specific feature, highlight, or benefit - 'look at this' moments - rather than a greeting or a calm explanation. 3s loop at 30fps (90 frames), 512x512.
notes: Same param/color convention and mouth-shape coordinates as wave-character.config.json / nod-character.config.json, so lip sync and the compositor work on it identically.
